sections.name: 阅读理解
sections.note: 每题 2 分。阅读所给文章，从四个选项中选出最佳答案。

passage.title: Sleep, memory and the cost of a short night
passage.text: Students have long treated sleep as a reserve to be spent before examinations. Laboratory work suggests this is a poor bargain. During deep sleep the brain replays patterns formed during the day, consolidating them into longer-term memory; cut the night short and the replay is cut short with it. In one experiment, participants who learned a list of words in the evening recalled more after a full night than after a half night, although the total study time was identical. The finding has an uncomfortable implication for schools that schedule early starts after late-night revision. Sleep is not time away from study; it is part of the process.

sections.name: 翻译
sections.note: 本题 12 分。把划线句子译成汉语，要求准确、通顺。

items.stem: During deep sleep the brain replays patterns formed during the day, consolidating them into longer-term memory; cut the night short and the replay is cut short with it.

answer.text: 在深度睡眠中，大脑会重放白天形成的活动模式，并将其巩固为长期记忆；若缩短夜间睡眠，这种重放也会随之被缩短。

explain.wrong: 常见错误：consolidating 是伴随状语，译成并列动作；cut the night short and… 是「祈使句 + and」表条件，译成「若……就……」；it 指 the night，需还原为「夜间睡眠」。

sections.name: 写作
sections.note: 本题 12 分。按题目要求写一篇短文。

items.stem: Write an essay of about 160 words on the following topic: many students reduce sleep before examinations. Explain why this is counterproductive and suggest better habits.

answer.text: Late-night revision feels productive because it is visible: the desk is occupied and the notes are open. Memory research suggests the feeling is misleading. During deep sleep the brain replays the patterns formed during the day and consolidates them, so a shortened night shortens the very process that turns study into recall. In controlled experiments, students who slept a full night remembered more than those who studied the same number of hours but slept half as long. The practical lesson is simple: review in the evening, sleep a full night, and test yourself in the morning. Schools can help by not scheduling early examinations immediately after late-night revision sessions.

explain.wrong: 常见错误：把「少睡」当成努力的象征，通篇鼓励熬夜；或只讲睡眠重要，不给可执行的替代方案。
